title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_153.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a polytemporal theory of personal identity in which multiple simultaneous lives — his own 1974 self, the apostle Thomas in CE 70 Rome, and an unborn three-eyed future being — are coordinated by a single overarching macro-intelligence he identifies with Zebra/the Holy Spirit. He argues that his novel 'Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said' is the master plural-worlds novel, covertly encoding this cosmology through material inserted by both past and future selves collaborating across time. In the second half of the entry he pivots to Platonic cosmology, reading F.M. Cornford's commentary on the Timaeus as confirmation of his 3-74 revelations: the universe is a living organism with a partially irrational world-soul (Ananke/Chance), and the Demiurge (Nous/Reason) can only persuade — not compel — it toward order, a model he uses to displace the omnipotent creator God of Judaism and orthodox Christianity.
key_claims: 'Flow My Tears' is the 'master plural worlds novel' among PKD's fiction, containing encoded testimony to the CE 70 Syria time-continuum that is more accurate than his other novels even though left unexplained.

PKD identifies himself as the apostle Thomas reincarnated (or polytemporal co-self), and argues the 'Acts'-like material in 'Tears' was deliberately encoded by Thomas to transmit across millennia the secret that Christ did not die but lives.

Multiple simultaneous selves — Thomas (CE 70), PKD (1974), and a three-eyed evolved future human — are subforms of a single supratemporal macro-mind (Zebra), which orchestrated the 3-74 crisis by allowing other 'styli' to bleed through when the current one could no longer handle its problems.

The brain's two hemispheres can be 'yoked in tandem' to different space-time continua, analogous to a radio tuned to one frequency while others remain simultaneously present; PKD's 3-74 experience was the firing of previously inhibited neural circuits tuned to the CE 70 continuum.

Plato's Timaeus, as interpreted by F.M. Cornford, exactly matches PKD's revelatory experience: the universe is a living organism with a world-soul containing an irrational element (Ananke/Chance) that the Demiurge (Nous) must persuade rather than compel.

The omnipotent creator God of Judaism and Christianity cannot account for the observable irrational element in the world, whereas Plato's cosmology does; PKD therefore proposes to accept the Timaeus framework, adding to it the descent of divine Wisdom (Sophia/Nous) into the sublunar world as the savior figure absent from Plato's own era.
recurring_concepts: Zebra — PKD's name for the macro-mind / ultra-terrestrial discorporate intelligence made of plasmatic energy, identified here with the Holy Spirit
Polytemporal self / macro-mind — the concept that PKD, Thomas, and a future three-eyed being are simultaneous subforms of one overarching intelligence
Styli — PKD's term for individual lives or selves through which the macro-mind writes/acts in linear time
Magdeburg Hemispheres — the metaphor for two brain hemispheres yoked to different space-time continua, like two vacuum hemispheres sealed together
Ananke — Platonic Chance/Necessity, the irrational constant in the world-soul that the Demiurge cannot eliminate but can only persuade toward order
Orthogonal / coaxial time — the concept of plural space-time continua mounted along an axis orthogonal to linear time, simultaneously present but normally inaccessible
Thomas — the inner alternate-self PKD identifies as a first-century Christian apostle whose world and memories bleed through in 3-74
St. Sophia / Holy Wisdom (Nous) — divine reason that descends into the microcosm as the savior; identified with Christ and with the penetrating rational principle in Platonic cosmology
The Xerox Missive — a document PKD believes came from the adversarial power, treating him as a mystical political radical
Urwelt / Urgeist — the primordial world and primordial spirit, the real home and real nature of humanity beneath layers of spurious accretion
people_entities: Thomas — the apostle whose identity PKD believes he shares or re-embodies across time; the author of secret steganographic messages encoded in PKD's own fiction
St. Sophia — divine Wisdom, a personified theological figure PKD hopes to meet face-to-face in a future life
Ted Sturgeon — SF writer (Theodore Sturgeon); PKD credits 'Ted' and Scott Apel with a theory of simultaneous former and later lives arranged in a circular pattern
Scott Apel — appears paired with Ted Sturgeon as co-originator of the 'simultaneous lives' theory PKD is testing
K. W. Jeter — SF writer and PKD associate; cited for the 'symbiosis' model of the macro-entity working with PKD
F.M. Cornford — classical scholar; PKD cites his interpretation of Plato's Timaeus as key philosophical confirmation
Plato — ancient Greek philosopher; his Timaeus is PKD's primary cosmological authority here
Anaxagoras — ancient Greek philosopher whom Plato censured for claiming Nous 'set the world spinning and then lost interest'; PKD endorses Plato's criticism
Christ / Jesus — the savior figure identified as the penetration of divine Nous/Sophia into the sublunar world; depicted as alive and yet to return
YHWH — the God of the Old Testament, characterized here as the 'irrational world soul,' capricious and powerful but below the rational Demiurge
texts_works: Plato, Timaeus — primary philosophical source; PKD reads it (via Cornford) as cosmological confirmation of his 3-74 vision
F.M. Cornford, Plato's Cosmology — scholarly commentary on the Timaeus; PKD quotes or paraphrases 'the dark domain of the irrational powers' (p. 210)
Book of Acts — the New Testament text PKD believes he encoded steganographically into 'Flow My Tears' as Thomas communicating across millennia
PKD, 'Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said' — his 1974 novel, theorized here as the master plural-worlds text containing encoded CE 70 testimony
PKD, 'Ubik' — cited for its implied theory of time and alternate realities
PKD, 'A Maze of Death' — cited as an earlier attempt at plural-reality explanation
PKD, 'The Three Stigmata of Palmer Eldritch' — cited alongside Maze and Ubik for plural-reality themes
PKD, 'The Man in the High Castle' — referred to as 'Joint' in PKD's abbreviation system, cited for plural realities
PKD, 'Eye in the Sky' — referred to as 'Eye,' cited for plural realities
PKD, 'The Electric Ant' (short story) — cited as an analog for the 'two reality tapes' situation PKD experienced in 3-74
autobiographical: In March 1974 (3-74) PKD experienced a breakthrough in which a previously sealed-off part of his mind fired, causing him to perceive himself simultaneously in 1974 California and in CE 70 Rome/Syria
During 3-74 PKD heard Koine Greek, feared persecution by the Romans, and felt 'taken over' by an inner personality he identifies as Thomas
PKD reports that during 3-74 he felt he had 'lived through that time span once before,' only this time an entity from the future had interfered to alter and improve the outcome

PKD notes behavioral anomalies suggesting a second contemporary self bled through: he suddenly switched to beer, called all dogs 'he' and all cats 'she,' knew how to drive a car but reached in the wrong place for the air vent
PKD received a 'Xerox Missive' he believes came from an adversarial power treating him as a mystical political radical, akin to AMORC
PKD states that the CE 70 life 'will always be the ideal one' for him, unless a later life brings a face-to-face encounter with St. Sophia
PKD reports that in high school the macro entity was already present in his life, surfacing to take full control only in 3-74
theological_motifs: Polytemporal incarnation — the soul distributed across multiple simultaneous lives coordinated by a macro-intelligence
Steganography as sacred transmission — the apostle Thomas encoding secret apostolic testimony in PKD's novels to survive across millennia
Demiurge / Nous (Reason) as persuader — the divine rational principle that can organize but not compel the irrational world-soul
Ananke — the irreducible irrational element in the cosmos, unaccounted for by the omnipotent creator God of Judaism and Christianity
The world-soul as partially irrational — Plato's Timaeus model of a living universe whose psyche contains a 'dark domain of irrational powers'
Sophia / Holy Wisdom — divine reason incarnating into the sublunar world as the savior, the element Plato lacked and PKD supplies
The Holy Spirit as Zebra — the ultra-terrestrial macro-mind identified with the Christian Holy Spirit, choosing and sanctifying its vessels
Apostolic selection — Christ chose the original Twelve, and the process is ongoing; PKD understands himself as among the chosen
Christ's deathlessness — the secret message Thomas encodes across time: 'He did not die but lives'
Platonistic Christianity — PKD's synthesis rejecting YHWH as the irrational world-soul and substituting the Platonic Demiurge/Nous as the true God, with Christ as the descent of Sophia
literary_self_ref: 'Flow My Tears' is identified as the 'master plural worlds novel' containing encoded CE 70 material inserted by Thomas (past self) and dream material inserted by a future three-eyed self — making it a collaboration across three time periods

PKD argues a full scholarly analysis of 'Tears,' informed by knowledge of supratemporal macro-entities, would conclude the author is claiming the real world is CE 70 Syria, and would reveal autobiographical data about PKD himself
PKD says 'Ubik' implies a theory of coaxial time and alternate realities, and that 'Tears' with its alternate-world synchronizations may be even closer to his cosmological model

PKD draws a parallel between his 3-74 experience and 'The Electric Ant': the discovery of two reality tapes running in the same brain, the analog of the android protagonist's punch-tape that generates his perceived world
PKD suggests combining 'Ubik' and 'Tears' yields a complete model: alternate times plus alternate presents, matching his polytemporal theory

PKD notes that 'Maze,' 'Ubik,' 'Stigmata,' 'The Man in the High Castle,' and 'Eye in the Sky' all attempt explanations of plural realities, but none achieves what 'Tears' does in actually describing those worlds accurately
symbols_images: Magdeburg Hemispheres — two evacuated metal hemispheres sealed by atmospheric pressure, used as a metaphor for two brain hemispheres locked to different space-time continua and 'yoked in tandem'
The LP record groove — linear time as a groove in a record; the person tracks one groove but all grooves are simultaneously present on the disc
The radio variable condenser / TV channel tuner — a model for how a person is 'locked' to one space-time frequency while others remain omnipresent but undetected
The stylus — individual human lives as writing instruments through which the macro-mind inscribes itself in linear time
The reality tape — from 'The Electric Ant,' a punch tape that generates the character's perceived world; here applied to the two time-streams PKD experienced simultaneously
The three-eyed future human — an evolved being who is one of the three confirmed polytemporal selves of PKD, able to receive his transmissions
Coaxial worlds — plural space-time continua mounted along an axis orthogonal to linear time, like coaxial cables
Plasmatic energy — the physical/ontological substrate of Zebra, the discorporate macro-mind
The injecting macro entity — the image of the supratemporal intelligence as something that 'injects' itself into a normal linear life and then runs it
tensions: PKD wavers between two explanatory models for 3-74: (1) he was 'bailed out' by simultaneous past/future lives, or (2) the macro-entity itself took over — he does not resolve which is primary
PKD is uncertain whether Thomas communicates to him and he relays to a future three-eyed being, or whether all three collaborate directly through the macro-mind without serial relay
PKD tentatively suggests a 'soviet national' as a possible second contemporary subform of the macro-mind, then immediately drops the speculation without resolution

PKD claims the CE 70 continuum is the 'real' one while the 1974 world is spurious, but he cannot fully account for why only one of the plural coaxial continua should be designated real rather than all being equally valid frequency-tracks

PKD's Platonic cosmology displaces YHWH as an irrational world-soul below the true Demiurge/Nous, yet he does not fully reconcile this with his identification of Christ/Sophia as the Demiurge's penetration — leaving unclear whether Christ redeems YHWH's domain or simply replaces it

PKD accepts Plato's model while adding what Plato could not have known (the savior/Sophia), but he acknowledges Plato 'censured Anaxagoras' for a view (Nous setting the world spinning then losing interest) that PKD also endorses criticizing — creating an unacknowledged circularity in his use of Plato as authority
evidence_quotes: "It's as if all my lives got together to handle the 3-74 problem, + that points to the 'injecting macro entity.'"

"Zebra is the macro mind, an UTI - ultra terrestrial lifeform, discorporate: plasmatic energy, for who all times are one. To Xtians it is known as the Holy Spirit, + those humans (+ animals!) which it acts in symbiosis with are [..] into polyforms of Christ, it sanctifies those whom it chooses + it is it which does the choosing."

"I'll bet anything that the 'Acts' material didn't just 'happen' (because I am also Thomas), but is a deliberate encoded message from Thomas, through me, designed to pass down the ages, into what is future for me too, as well as future for Thomas."
"not only does the omnipotent creator God of the Jews + Christians not fit observable facts, it also does not fit my revelation. Plato's cosmology does."
"A previously sealed off + merely latent part of my mind (brain) is 'Magdabourg Hemisphered' to another space-time continuum."
uncertainty_flags: PKD spells 'Magdeburg' as 'Magdabourg' — this is likely a phonetic misspelling; the reference is to the Magdeburg hemispheres experiment of Otto von Guericke (1654)

The 'Scott Apel' cited alongside Ted Sturgeon as co-originator of the simultaneous-lives theory is likely the SF interviewer and PKD associate Kevin Jeter's circle acquaintance; his precise role in developing the theory is not explained in the text

PKD refers to a 'Xerox Missive' he believes came from 'the adversary' — the specific document, its actual content, and its true origin are not described; this requires cross-reference to other Exegesis segments

The phrase 'Thomas communicates 1000s of years ahead in time' and the identification of PKD as Thomas raises the question of whether PKD intends literal reincarnation, polytemporal co-identity, or metaphorical apostolic succession — the text is ambiguous

PKD references 'Ted Sturgeon's theory of the circle of war' — this is an unusual formulation; Sturgeon's known published works do not contain a theory by this name, suggesting it may have been conveyed to PKD in conversation or correspondence not otherwise documented
The Cornford page reference ('P 210') and the quoted phrase 'the dark domain of the irrational powers' should be verified against Cornford's Plato's Cosmology (1937); the paraphrase may be loose

PKD notes behavioral anomalies (switching to beer, cat/dog pronoun usage, reaching for the wrong air vent) as evidence of a second contemporary subform — these are presented as autobiographical facts but could also be post-hoc rationalization of ordinary behavioral variation

raw_text: "Tears" is the really pregnant one. In "Maze" + "Ubik" + "Stigmata" some kind of attempted explanation is given, as in "Joint" + "Eye" of the plural realities, but not so in "Tears" yet "Tears" contains descriptions of the proving of these other worlds which are more accurate albeit unexplained than the other novels. "Tears" is the master plural worlds novel of them all - + what if the "Acts" material is discerned? A totally correct + complete analysis of "Tears" would have to conclude that the author is saying, "the real world is not what we see it is - can be - nothing other than CE 70 Syria" + if the analysis is based on a knowledge of the existence of this or these supratemporal macro entities it would have to conclude that my taproot ([..]) self currently is a Xtian c. CE 70 in Rome. So the analysis could come up with some unusual information about me as well as the book. Hence the Xerox Missive, which I'm sure came from the adversary. We're probably regarded as mystical political radicals involved with the occult or supernatural, like AMORC: undermining the established authority, which is exactly what we are doing. For me, the CE 70 life will always be the ideal one - unless there is a later one when St. Sophia returns + I see him/her face-to-face. I'll bet anything that the "Acts" material didn't just "happen" (because I am also Thomas), but is a deliverate encoded message from Thomas, through me, designed to pass down the ages, into what is future for me too, as well as future for Thomas. He is communicating 1000s of years ahead in time the sacred text, knowing that a time will come Probably after my time, when the encoded message will be perceived + read + understood by some one + what is the message hidden in the "in [..] bulk" of the text. That he (Christ) did not die but lives. It is an apostolic Xtian communicating (in the customary stegenographic way) down through the millenia, lest the secret be forgotten or lost. He lives + will return. Or maybe has already returned - could that be what the signal says? But more likely Thomas communicates to me + I communicate to the 3-eyed future one. Through my writing 3 time periods (or more) link up as we greet one another. + work in unison. In a case like mine (3-74) when a "stylus" could no longer handle problems, + the macro entity wanted a problem handled + so allowed other "styli" to bleed through, the waning stylus would not only receive an understanding of its immortality, but an understanding of the [..] of the total mechanism + situation, inc post mortem experiences with the macro mind (Zebra, St. Sophia). ---------- "Brains yoked in tandem." Maybe it's the explanation, across vast stretches of linear linear time. Tracing simultaneously. ---------- A very strange idea has come to me re this "brain yoked in tandem." If the manifestation of the (inner personality Thomas + the analog CE 70 Syria world are the result of the firing of up-to-then inhibited brain circuits the locus of Thomas is in my brain + so is his world, which brings us to an "Electric Ant" situation, but with two reality tapes, not [one] the irreality of our given space-time continuum is totally affirmed. A previously sealed off + merely latent part of my mind (brain) is "Magdabourg Hemisphered" to another space-time continuum. This would imply - wait.. it does not prove that reality is generated by the person; there could be something like a series of "frequencies" of plural space-time continua, into one of which the person is locked, to the exclusion of the others although they are there. The variable condensor of a radio (or channel tuner of a tv set) might be a model to turn to. So even space-time continuum is omnipresent, but the person tracks the groove - ascends the manifold of linear time (the LP groove). We are carefully tuned to a time frequency, + stayed locked to it until death. But if Sturgeon is correct, in some way we simultaneously are also locked into other parts of the groove. There is compartmentalization here. Just as FM station transmissions do not impinge on one another (whereas AM do.). Again, "Ubik" seems to imply this, re time + reality. There is even theorization in that novel. "Tears," despite the synchronization of time in the various "alternate worlds" may even be closer. Suppose the two novels are combined; we get alternate times + alternate presents. I had the distinct impression in 3-74 that I had lived through that time span once before, only this time a power or entity from the future had interferred to alter + improve it. This time it came out different, + deliberately so. If my total brain is tracking several space-time continua, I say that the CE 70 one is the real one. there is something spurious about the others which does not afflict that track Reality must be understood as a coherent set of signals directed at us, detected by us + hypostated into substantiality, each accretion of linear time is [laid] down over the previous tracks, but the previous ones (or the unique, true one) can be retrieved. With the urwelt (externally) there is the inner analog of the urgeist. [..] not only man's real home but his real nature - stripped like the world, of layers of the spurious. It is the basis of Greek thought to state that our empirical world is an illusion, concealing a real one behind it - but nowhere is the notion put forth that the real one behind it is an earlier time continuum which once long ago, was the phenomenal world - now sunk inside + [wider.] The manifestation (intervention, memory) of a future me does not prove Ted Sturgeon's theory of the circle of war correct, but it gives weight to the argument. I can reason that a linear future me intervened backward in time, inserted material in "Tears" etc, but that doesn't explain Thomas or why I found myself in both "my" 1974 world + "his" AD 70 world. So I think Ted is correct. It's as if all my lives got together to handle the 3-74 problem, + that points to the "injecting macro entity." ---------- I have to get perspective on this. The Ted Sturgeon - Scott Apel notice of simultaneous "former" + "later" lives is absolutely the explanantion of why 1) I saw Rome; 2) I believed I was in danger from the Romans; 3) heard the koine; 4) was taken over by "Thomas." Either another of the simultaneous lives broke through to me or I broke through to it. + part of the theory is that the full script of each of the selected lives is known to the macro mind before it injects itself into it. Suppose there was a PKD who merely began a normal linear time life in 1928 - + lived it out to its end. Then a macro entity injected itself into this life (as well as past + future ones; e.g. Thomas, the 3-eyed evolved humans; etc) +, in symbiosis, as Jeter believes, worked with me, surfacing to take full control in 3-74 (But it was there back when I was in high school, + later too). This macro entity runs a number of lives spread out along the linear time line in sequence. But, for it, simultaneously. Either I was bailed out by the macro entity or by other lives. Past + future Christianity is involved; the macro mind - which I saw extension as Zebra - Christ. In any case, I am one part of either a supratemporal macro intelligence or a poly temporal intelligence. I'm not "the only game in town," the only entry in the race. But it is not PKD who is this. PKD normally only has knowledge of this one "entry" in the race, [Diagram] Macro mind → Thomas AD 70 / Macro mind → PKD 1974 / Macro mind → Future There may be several or even many more, or a few more - but I'm sure of 3. It is also possible for the macro mind to operate more than one subform in the same linear - time continuum. (Thus explaining why I suddenly switched to beer, called all dogs he + all cats she, knew how to drive a car but reached in the wrong place for the air vent.) (Suppose - just suppose - the other linear-time contemporary is a soviet national.) A future self wouldn't have to transmit to me via such external carriers as tachyons; it, knowing about all this, could/would do so via the quelle: the macro mind. Maybe the future of the polytemporal lives would be test this theory out. When the dream material appeared in "Tears" it would know it (he or she) was me - + the Acts material would disclose "Thomas" as well. So the "Acts" material came from a past self + the dream material from a future one. 3 of the polytemporal selves collaborated on "Tears." Maybe "Tears" originally was published with only the "Acts" material cooked into it. The future self figured out about me + Thomas - + either also figured out about its relation to us or suspected it. To [twist] it, it would have to work via the macromind - tachyons carried material would get info back to the past, which is a heavy thought, but I think this future self wanted to establish contact with itself specifically. Zebra is the macro mind, an UTI - ultra terrestrial lifeform, discorporate: plasmatic energy, for who all times are one. To Xtians it is known as the Holy Spirit, + those humans (+ animals!) which it acts in symbiosis with are [..] into polyforms of Christ, it sanctifies those whom it chooses + it is it which does the choosing. It chose the original 12 + is still chosing. Anyhow, the simultaneity of time opens up, finally, an absolutely certain, proven explanation. Coaxial worlds, as I [..] called them. But the demiurge (Noos) must the persuade - cannot compel - necessity (chance, there chaotic) into order. Therefore, cornford concludes, must be an irrational element in the world-soul a then would be no onrate the note to persuade it is very significant that the demiurge cannot compel). This chaos did not preceed order, but is a constant in the universe. The omnipotent creator God of the Jews + Xtians is a concept which does not accout for this element that cornford calls "the dark domain of the irrational powers" (P 210). Also, Plato's cosmology in Timaeus, as cornford interprets it (probably correctly) coincides exactly with what I experienced in 3-74 " except I add him who had not yet come in Plato's time: the savior, who is the penetration of Holy wisdom (noÃ¶s) into the microcosm. not only does the omnipotent creator God of the Jews + Christians not fit observable facts, it also does not fit my revelation.
